prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1189; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Baytown, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you have it on file already, so go ahead and use that.

Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the impact?

A: I was heading through the intersection on a green light, going maybe thirty miles an hour. I had just crossed the middle of the intersection when a car came from my right side and clipped the front of my door area. Honestly, it happened so fast.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not until right before. I think it was coming in from a side street and didn't stop. I hit the brakes, but there wasn't time.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: How did you feel after the collision?

A: My left wrist hurt right away. My arm hit the door frame and the window. I couldn't really grip the steering wheel. Someone pulled me out of the car and the ambulance took me to the hospital.

Q: Do you know what the diagnosis was?

A: They told me it was a fracture of the wrist. I have a cast now and I'm seeing a specialist next week. I can't work the same way right now because I use that hand for most of my job.

Q: Did you receive any treatment at the scene or afterward?

A: Paramedics checked me at the scene, then I was treated at the emergency room. They splinted it and gave me pain medication. I'm still going to appointments.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and I want this handled fairly. That's all I have.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
